split_reasoning: Warnings may be given directly to a violator during a live contact or sent afterward as written notices.

parts.text: Warn a violator directly about an infraction or potential penalty.
parts.type_reasoning: The warning is delivered through a live interaction with the person concerned.
parts.overlap_reasoning: Reporting a violation to an agency is a separate action from warning the violator.

parts.text: Send a written warning about an infraction or potential penalty.
parts.type_reasoning: Each written warning is a document the recipient can rely on.
parts.unit_reasoning: A warning notice is issued for a particular violation or set of related violations.
parts.start: violation identified and details available for notification
parts.end: warning notice sent to the violator
parts.overlap_reasoning: A warning to the violator is distinct from a report to an agency or a licensing-decision letter.

notes: The balance between direct and written warnings depends on the enforcement program.

split_reasoning: Applications, records, and other documents are alternative inputs to the same eligibility or liability evaluation.

parts.text: Evaluate submitted applications and other records to gather information about an eligibility or liability issue.
parts.type_reasoning: Each evaluation produces findings used in a particular case.
parts.unit_reasoning: The case-level evaluation, rather than each document read, is the unit passed to the decision-maker.
parts.work_item: one case's application or records evaluated
parts.start: application or case records received for review
parts.end: relevant eligibility or liability findings recorded or passed to the decision-maker
parts.overlap_reasoning: Test results and inspection records can be inputs to this evaluation, but scoring tests and visiting establishments are separate activities.

split_reasoning: Regulatory advice is provided both during live contacts and in responses prepared afterward or from written requests.

parts.text: Advise a licensee or other person about licensing, permit, or passport regulations during a live contact.
parts.type_reasoning: The officer provides guidance while the person seeking it is present or on the line.
parts.unit_reasoning: One inquiry is addressed within a call or visit.
parts.work_item: one live regulatory advice inquiry handled
parts.start: person asks about a licensing, permit, or passport requirement
parts.end: guidance is given during the contact
parts.overlap_reasoning: Gathering facts for a licensing decision and communicating a decision are distinct from advising on regulations.

parts.text: Prepare written regulatory guidance for a licensee or other individual or group.
parts.type_reasoning: A written response is a distinct deliverable provided without the recipient waiting in a live contact.
parts.unit_reasoning: The complete response to an inquiry is the item sent to the requester.
parts.start: written inquiry or request for follow-up guidance received
parts.checked_by: the requester and, for sensitive advice, a supervisor
parts.overlap_reasoning: A decision or appeals letter may explain regulations, but it also communicates a specific decision or process.

notes: The shares depend on the program's use of phone, counter, and written inquiries.

split_reasoning: Activities, evaluations, recommendations, and decisions are subjects of the same report-preparation activity.

parts.text: Prepare a report of compliance activities, evaluations, recommendations, or decisions.
parts.type_reasoning: Each report is a distinct document used by colleagues or decision-makers.
parts.unit_reasoning: The completed report, whether about a case or a reporting period, is the item submitted.
parts.start: case findings or activity information assembled for reporting
parts.overlap_reasoning: A report of violations to an agency can also be a report of activities or findings, although each statement covers other reports.

split_reasoning: Reporting different law or regulation violations to different authorities is one activity with the same kind of output.

parts.text: Report a law or regulation violation to the appropriate board or agency.
parts.type_reasoning: Each referral or report provides a distinct account for an authority to act on.
parts.unit_reasoning: A report concerning a violation or related set of violations is sent as a whole to the receiving authority.
parts.work_item: one violation report submitted to a board or agency
parts.start: violation identified and information available for reporting
parts.end: report or referral submitted to the appropriate authority
parts.checked_by: receiving board or agency and compliance supervisor
parts.overlap_reasoning: Violation reports can also be activity or evaluation reports, but neither statement is limited to the other's scope.

split_reasoning: Conferring with and interviewing different sources are alternative ways to obtain or clarify facts for licensing decisions.

parts.text: Confer with or interview an official, specialist, or applicant to clarify facts relevant to a licensing decision.
parts.type_reasoning: The target is the live fact-gathering interaction rather than a separately specified written product.
parts.overlap_reasoning: Evaluating documents and advising people about regulations are different activities from interviewing sources for facts.

notes: Any subsequent written record or report is not separately specified in this target.

split_reasoning: Licenses can be issued while a qualified applicant waits or processed afterward in a back-office queue.

parts.text: Issue a license to a qualified individual during a live contact.
parts.type_reasoning: The license is issued while the applicant is present or on the line.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each qualifying applicant receives a license as a completed transaction.
parts.work_item: one license issued during an applicant contact
parts.start: applicant's eligibility is established during the contact
parts.end: license is issued and issuance confirmed to the applicant
parts.overlap_reasoning: Evaluating eligibility, collecting fees, and writing decision correspondence are separate steps in the licensing workflow.

parts.text: Issue a license to a qualified individual through back-office processing.
parts.type_reasoning: The license is processed and issued without the applicant waiting in a live contact.
parts.unit_reasoning: The issued license is the individual authorization delivered to the applicant.
parts.work_item: one license issued through back-office processing
parts.start: approved applicant's case is ready for issuance
parts.end: license is issued and sent or made available to the applicant
parts.overlap_reasoning: Eligibility evaluation and decision correspondence are related but have different outputs.

notes: The live and back-office shares vary by license type and issuing system.

split_reasoning: License fees are collected both during live applicant contacts and from payments processed afterward or received by mail.

parts.text: Collect a license fee while an applicant is present or on the line.
parts.type_reasoning: The payment transaction occurs while the applicant waits in a live contact.
parts.unit_reasoning: One fee payment is accepted and confirmed as a transaction.
parts.work_item: one license fee payment collected during a live contact
parts.start: fee is due and the applicant offers payment
parts.end: payment is recorded and receipt or confirmation provided
parts.checked_by: the applicant and licensing agency cashier or finance staff
parts.overlap_reasoning: Issuing a license and collecting its fee are separate workflow steps.

parts.text: Process a license fee payment received outside a live applicant contact.
parts.type_reasoning: A mailed or otherwise queued payment is recorded without the applicant waiting.
parts.unit_reasoning: Each payment is applied to an applicant's licensing account as a completed transaction.
parts.work_item: one queued license fee payment processed
parts.start: payment and identifying information received for processing
parts.end: payment recorded against the applicant's account and receipt issued as required
parts.checked_by: licensing agency finance staff and the applicant
parts.overlap_reasoning: The payment transaction is distinct from the issuance of the license.

notes: Payment channels and the extent to which officers themselves process fees vary by agency.

split_reasoning: Oral, written, road, and flight tests are alternative formats for administering a licensing test; scoring and rating are covered separately.

parts.text: Administer a licensing test to an applicant.
parts.type_reasoning: The officer conducts or proctors the test while the applicant participates in person or another live setting.
parts.unit_reasoning: One applicant's test session is administered as a whole and its responses or test record are handed on for scoring.
parts.start: applicant presents for the scheduled test
parts.end: test session ends and responses or test record are collected
parts.checked_by: the applicant and the officer or team responsible for scoring
parts.overlap_reasoning: Observing an applicant and scoring performance can occur during administration, but rating ability is a separate output.

notes: Some written tests may be delivered through automated systems rather than directly administered by an officer.

split_reasoning: Checking displayed permits and checking licensing standards are both components of an on-site establishment inspection.

parts.text: Visit an establishment to verify displayed licenses or permits and compliance with licensing standards.
parts.type_reasoning: The inspection requires the officer to visit and examine conditions at the establishment.
parts.overlap_reasoning: Inspecting licensing records on site can overlap with evaluating records, but the visit also examines physical compliance conditions.

notes: Preparing an inspection report is covered separately by the reporting statement.

split_reasoning: Scoring tests and observing practical equipment operation are different activities, and test scoring occurs both during live contacts and afterward.

parts.text: Score a completed licensing test after the applicant's live session.
parts.type_reasoning: The officer produces a score or rating from completed test material without the applicant waiting.
parts.unit_reasoning: One applicant's completed test is scored and passed on for the licensing decision.
parts.start: completed test or response record received for scoring
parts.end: score or rating recorded and made available to the licensing decision-maker
parts.overlap_reasoning: Test administration and case evaluation use or produce related information but are not identical to scoring.

parts.text: Score an applicant's test during a live testing contact.
parts.type_reasoning: The score or rating is determined while the applicant remains in the live session.
parts.unit_reasoning: One applicant's test is scored and the result is recorded or communicated during the session.
parts.work_item: one licensing test scored during the applicant's session
parts.start: applicant completes the test or a scorable portion during the session
parts.end: score or rating recorded and communicated as appropriate
parts.overlap_reasoning: Administering the test can overlap with live scoring, while the broader case evaluation may use the resulting score.

parts.text: Observe an applicant operating equipment and rate the applicant's ability.
parts.type_reasoning: The officer assesses performance while the applicant is participating in a live practical test.
parts.unit_reasoning: The rating for one applicant's practical performance is the assessment passed to the licensing process.
parts.work_item: one applicant's practical equipment operation rated
parts.start: applicant begins the observed equipment-operation test
parts.end: performance rating is recorded and communicated as appropriate
parts.overlap_reasoning: Observation can be part of administering a practical test, and the resulting rating may be used in evaluating the application.

notes: Shares depend on the mix of written and practical tests and whether scores are finalized during the session.

split_reasoning: Licensing decisions and appeals processes are alternative subjects of correspondence to concerned parties.

parts.text: Prepare correspondence informing a concerned party of a licensing decision or appeals process.
parts.type_reasoning: Each letter or other written communication is a distinct deliverable sent to a recipient.
parts.unit_reasoning: The complete case-specific communication is the item sent and retained in the licensing record.
parts.work_item: one licensing decision or appeals communication
parts.start: decision or appeals information is available for communication
parts.end: correspondence is completed and sent to the concerned party
parts.overlap_reasoning: A decision or appeals communication may also give regulatory guidance, but each statement covers communications outside the other's scope.
